senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Putiel, the father-in-law of Elazar, son of Aaron, in Agadah identified with Jethro (and also with Joseph). Mekh. Yithro, ʿĂmal., s. 1 פ̇וט̇' שנפ̇ט̇ר מע״ז Jethro was surnamed Putiel, because he withdrew from idolatry.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 109b:12">B. Bath. 109ᵇ</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="Q00535"><he>פָּטַם</he></cite> a. <cite ref="Q00184"><he>פּוֹטָא</he></cite>.
